title: Group Gathering at Home Party, 1960 Vintage B&W Photo
description: A square black-and-white snapshot stamped APR 60 on the top white border depicting a large group of young girls and adults gathered inside a mid-century living room. A woman standing on the left holds a sign or book that reads COOK BOOK, while an adult man poses on the far right. The background features wood-paneled walls, a brick fireplace with a sunburst clock, and balloon decorations hanging from the ceiling.
